##### Project general facts

Creekside Residence by Al Zorah Development Company is a waterfront residential building set along a tranquil creekside promenade and overlooking a preserved mangrove forest. Mediterranean-inspired architecture is combined with a striking form that takes inspiration from grand amphitheatres, allowing each home to become a private viewing box towards the creek, the marina and the golf fairways. The building rises above lower ground levels and a ground floor to eight residential floors and a rooftop, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments.

Amenities are designed for a refined, resort-inspired lifestyle. Residents enjoy internal gardens and lush landscaped areas, a fully equipped gym, a multipurpose room and a children's play area. A grand entrance overlooks the creek, and an internal courtyard brings natural light throughout the building. Community access is provided through a private, secure entrance with round-the-clock security and CCTV, while underground parking and marina berthing facilities add everyday convenience.

Interiors are finished with high-quality materials and thoughtfully planned layouts that create a natural flow between living spaces. Panoramic windows frame views of the surrounding nature, and balconies extend living areas outdoors. Open kitchens come with space for appliances, while larger layouts add dressing rooms, powder rooms and master bathrooms. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Zorah City is a gated coastal destination in Ajman, designed around parks, pedestrian paths, cycling routes and landscaped sidewalks that connect residential areas with leisure spaces. A tidal lagoon and inland creek are overlaid by a lush mangrove forest, home to native and migratory birds, fish and indigenous flora, making the area a favourite for nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts.

The Nicklaus Design championship golf course, the golf and yacht clubhouse, the Zoya Health and Wellbeing Resort and several marinas lie within the community, alongside a professional cycling trail. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Dubai, Dubai International Airport and Sharjah International Airport, while Ajman City Centre, Ajman University and hospitals are a short drive away. The community is also easily reached by boat or yacht through its marinas.

Al Zorah City is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most distinctive coastal communities in the northern emirates. Waterfront homes overlooking the mangroves and golf course are in limited supply, supporting demand from families and investors. Accessible entry points compared with Dubai and a growing resort and leisure offer underpin long-term value and resilient resale prospects.
